targets.rawQueryText: SELECT b.name AS Budget, s.date AS Date, CAST(s.allocated AS REAL) AS Allocated, CAST(s.equity AS REAL) AS Equity, ROUND(CAST(s.return_percent AS REAL), 2) AS "Return %", CAST(s.realized_pnl AS REAL) AS Realized, CAST(s.unrealized_pnl AS REAL) AS Unrealized, s.open_positions AS Positions, s.orders_placed AS "Orders (day)", s.fills AS "Fills (day)", (SELECT group_concat(a.name, ', ') FROM budget_automations m JOIN automations a ON a.id = m.automation_id WHERE m.budget_id = b.id) AS Automations FROM budget_snapshots s JOIN budgets b ON b.id = s.budget_id WHERE s.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM budget_snapshots x WHERE x.budget_id = s.budget_id) AND s.portfolio_id = '${portfolio}' ORDER BY "Return %" DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT b.name AS Budget, s.date AS Date, CAST(s.allocated AS REAL) AS Allocated, CAST(s.equity AS REAL) AS Equity, ROUND(CAST(s.return_percent AS REAL), 2) AS "Return %", CAST(s.realized_pnl AS REAL) AS Realized, CAST(s.unrealized_pnl AS REAL) AS Unrealized, s.open_positions AS Positions, s.orders_placed AS "Orders (day)", s.fills AS "Fills (day)", (SELECT group_concat(a.name, ', ') FROM budget_automations m JOIN automations a ON a.id = m.automation_id WHERE m.budget_id = b.id) AS Automations FROM budget_snapshots s JOIN budgets b ON b.id = s.budget_id WHERE s.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM budget_snapshots x WHERE x.budget_id = s.budget_id) AND s.portfolio_id = '${portfolio}' ORDER BY "Return %" DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT o.created_at AS Created, o.side AS Side, CAST(o.quantity AS REAL) AS Qty, o.symbol AS Symbol, o.type AS Type, o.status AS Status, CAST(o.average_fill_price AS REAL) AS "Avg fill", CAST(o.estimated_price AS REAL) AS Estimated, COALESCE(b.name, '—') AS Budget, COALESCE(a.name, 'manual') AS "Placed by" FROM orders o LEFT JOIN automations a ON a.id = o.automation_id LEFT JOIN budgets b ON b.id = o.budget_id WHERE o.portfolio_id = '${portfolio}' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
targets.queryText: SELECT o.created_at AS Created, o.side AS Side, CAST(o.quantity AS REAL) AS Qty, o.symbol AS Symbol, o.type AS Type, o.status AS Status, CAST(o.average_fill_price AS REAL) AS "Avg fill", CAST(o.estimated_price AS REAL) AS Estimated, COALESCE(b.name, '—') AS Budget, COALESCE(a.name, 'manual') AS "Placed by" FROM orders o LEFT JOIN automations a ON a.id = o.automation_id LEFT JOIN budgets b ON b.id = o.budget_id WHERE o.portfolio_id = '${portfolio}' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.ran_at AS "Ran at", a.name AS Automation, r.status AS Status, json_extract(r.result, '$.metrics.matchedCount') AS Matched, json_extract(r.result, '$.metrics.placedCount') AS Placed, json_extract(r.result, '$.metrics.skippedCount') AS Skipped, r.error AS Error FROM runs r JOIN automations a ON a.id = r.subject_id WHERE r.kind = 'AUTOMATION' ORDER BY r.ran_at DESC LIMIT 100
